when_used: The registered proprietors instruct a surveyor to subdivide, re-parcel, combine, partition or change the boundaries of the parcels in a title, and sign Part A of the form while the surveyor completes Part B, the Government Surveyor Part C and the Land Registrar Part D.
title_line: (This form is to be completed in triplicate.)
Part A: Title Details and Registered Proprietor(s) instructions to the Surveyor

body_text.text: Instructions of Registered Proprietor(s) to the Surveyor*
The Proprietor(s) of the above noted Parcel(s) HEREBY instructs the Surveyor to carry out the following (tick as appropriate):
Subdivide the parcel as shown on page two/as per attached approved scheme plan
Re-parcel the parcels noted above as shown on page two/as per attached approved scheme plan
Combine the parcels noted above as shown on page two/as per attached approved scheme plan.
Partition the parcel noted above as shown on page two/as per attached approved scheme plan.
Change the common boundaries of the parcels noted above as shown on page two/as per attached approved scheme plan.
The boundaries are to be surveyed according to the area(s) as shown on page two/as per attached approved scheme plan.
The boundaries are to be surveyed as they exist on the ground as shown on page two/as per attached approved scheme plan.
(An Approved Scheme Plan may be attached)
CERTIFY that the above-named Proprietor(s) appeared before me on the ….……. day of ….……………… 20……. and being known to me/being identified by
…………………………………………… of ………………....................... acknowledged the above signature(s) or mark(s) to be his/hers/theirs and that he/she/they had freely and voluntarily executed this instrument .

registry_block: Part D: Registration by the Land Registrar
Signature and Number of Land Registrar………………….…………………
foot_notes: *The person certifying should be a Surveyor or an Advocate of the High Court of Kenya or Licensed Physical Planner

custom_fields.label: Address of the registered proprietor(s)
custom_fields.prompt: Postal address of the registered proprietor or proprietors, as the title carries it

custom_fields.label: Schedule of the parcels
